subject.title: fix(workboard): separate orchestration from hard dependencies

question: Should omitted decomposition mode preserve the prior hard-dependency semantics for existing callers and stored cards, with orchestration selected only explicitly or through a narrowly proven migration?
rationale: The PR changes a persisted workflow default and rewrites existing SQLite relationships; code review cannot determine whether the intended permanent contract is compatibility-first migration or a deliberate behavior change.

options.title: Preserve omitted-mode compatibility
options.body: Keep omitted mode and pre-existing unmarked decompositions blocking, then require explicit orchestration metadata or a narrowly proven migration for non-blocking behavior.

options.title: Adopt orchestration as the upgrade default
options.body: Accept that existing unmarked decompositions become non-blocking, but document the breaking workflow change and provide upgraded-state proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Preserve omitted-mode compatibility
recommendation.body: Keep omitted mode and pre-existing unmarked decompositions blocking, then require explicit orchestration metadata or a narrowly proven migration for non-blocking behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: A current Workboard-area owner is needed to choose the persisted dependency contract; the supplied history is insufficient to name one reliably.
